notes: Passive (unpowered) 12-inch subwoofer — driven by an external amplifier via speaker-level cable, so it has no AC/DC power inlet of its own; no power port is listed. Enclosure is a freestanding ground-stack/suspended cabinet (16 suspension points, M10 hardware), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Available in Black (standard) or White (on request); weatherized WRC/WRX variants have different cabinet dimensions per JBL (contact CustomAudio@harman.com) — none of this affects the I/O. Neither connector (Speakon speaker-level audio, barrier strip) belongs to any graded connector scale (SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/RJ45), so no "grade" field was set on either port, per instructions. Part of JBL's AE Series / Cinema Sound - Immersive Rooms lineup.

ports.name: Speakon
ports.note: NL4 Neutrik Speakon; wired electrically in parallel with the barrier strip terminal for loop-through daisy-chaining to another cabinet.

ports.name: Barrier Strip
ports.note: CE-compliant covered barrier strip terminal block (accepts up to 10 AWG wire or 9mm spade lugs); 'euroblock' is the closest available connector id in the schema — this is a screw/barrier terminal strip, not a literal Euroblock. Wired in parallel with the Speakon jack for loop-through.
